operating_notes.text: Ceigall India emerged as H1 bidder for Water Resources Department Punjab de-silting order worth ₹0.14 Cr with 20 days execution period.
CIL-SAM India JV (Ceigall 74%) won ₹918.04 Cr (incl. 18% GST) Jaipur Metro Phase-II contract covering 10.8 km and 10 stations over 34 months.
Received ₹0.14 Cr LOA from Water Resources Department Punjab for de-silting with 20 days execution period.

Authority's Engineer completion certificate dated 5 May 2026 covers 35.15 km of the ₹881 Cr Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway package (Bhawanigarh–Bhogiwal, Punjab), completed 26 February 2026 except the de-linking part.
Total order book stood at ₹18,554.30 Cr as of 31 March 2026.
Total order book stood at ₹18,554 crores as of March 31, 2026.
Selected for setting up 100 MW Standalone BESS in Punjab with a project cost of about ₹250 Cr and a 12-year agreement.
Selected by PSPCL for a 50 MW standalone BESS in Punjab under RFS No. 61/PSPCL/1000 MWh/ELEC/ED-1861/(BESS-3), project cost about ₹125 Cr, tariff ₹2.99/kWh, 18 months execution and a 12-year BESPA.
Southern Ayodhya Bypass achieved 35% physical progress and Project Milestone II 92 days ahead of schedule.
Signed SPA on 3 June 2026 to sell CMASH (FY26 revenue ₹82.69 Cr, net worth ₹136.11 Cr) to Neo Infra Income Opportunity Fund for ₹177 Cr (consideration + cash surplus).
Executed SPA to sell CMASH (FY26 turnover ₹82.69 Cr, net worth ₹136.11 Cr) to Neo Infra Income Opportunity Fund for approximately ₹177 Cr including cash surplus.
Order book of ₹18,568 Cr as of June 30, 2026, spans 19 EPC, 10 HAM, 1 DBFOT, and 9 tariff-based renewable and transmission projects.
Equity invested in HAM and solar projects stood at ₹692 Cr as of August 10, 2026, with FY27 commitment of ₹859 Cr and FY28 of ₹744 Cr.
Capital expenditure in Q1FY27 was ~₹14 Cr, with full-year guidance of ₹30-35 Cr.
Delhi PWD road strengthening tender of ₹330.84 Cr (incl. GST) cancelled in view of documentary consideration; company was L1 bidder.
Ceigall India-Sushee Infra Mining JV (74:26) won 4 EPC LOAs from MoRTH for NH-913 Arunachal Pradesh totaling ₹2,149.62 Cr with 36-48 months construction and 5-year maintenance.

Ceigall India (70%) and Rajinder Infrastructure (30%) JV received an LOA from MoRTH for ₹274.08 Cr (excl. GST) EPC project on NH-913 Bile-Migging section, Arunachal Pradesh (48-month construction, 5-year maintenance).
Approved ₹29.44 Cr equity infusion in tranches into SPV Ceigall Indore Ujjain Greenfield Highway Ltd (74% direct, 26% via CIPPL) for 48.1 km HAM highway project.
Cumulative wins on NH-913 Frontier Highway reached 5 packages spanning 278 km worth ₹2,423.70 Cr within two days.
Received LOA from HPSIDC for ₹225.00 Cr (including GST) item rate contract for Bulk Drug Park Phase-I at Una, HP (18-month execution).
Received LOA from MoRTH for ₹704.70 Cr (excl. GST) EPC package on NH-913 Arunachal Pradesh in 74:26 JV with Sushee Infra & Mining (48-month construction, 5-year maintenance).
Emerging L1 bidder for Common Transmission System (765/400 kV AIS Substation with 300 km Transmission Line) from RECPDCL with annual charges of ₹608.67 Cr for 35 years and 36-month execution.
Commissioned first 5 MW solar power plant at Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra under MSKVY 2.0 ahead of schedule, out of 147 MW SPV portfolio.

Received LoI from RECPDCL for Common Transmission System (Lakadia/Jam Khambhaliya/Jamnagar evacuation) with approx project cost of ₹5,300 Cr (incl. GST) and annual charges of ₹608.67 Cr for 35 years (36-month execution).
Received LoI from RECPDCL for Gujarat common transmission system of ~₹5,300 Cr (incl. GST) with ₹608.67 Cr annual transmission charges for 35 years and 36-month execution.
Emerged as H1 bidder for stone block mining lease in Nawada District (Lot-4, Bhadokhara Block-D) from Bihar Mines Dept for cumulative value of ₹214.52 Cr over 5 years (4,19,300 cum/yr reserve).
Approved acquiring 100% of Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited from RECPDCL for ₹5 Lakh to execute the TBCB transmission project.
Approved 49% equity subscription (₹49,000) in proposed JV HC Concessions Limited with HCC Infrastructure Company Limited.
Subsidiary Ceigall Green Energy MH2 Limited commissioned another 5 MW solar unit (total 10 MW of planned 147 MW) at Ranjangaon Deshmukh under MSKVY 2.0 selling power to MSEDCL.
Approved equity infusion of ₹61.93 Cr into Ceigall Sahebganj Bettiah Highway Limited for NH 139W highway project
Received LOI from Government of Bihar for ₹214.52 Cr stone mining project in Nawada district
Entered into SPA with RECPDCL to acquire 100% of Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited for ₹18.40 Cr as part of TBCB transmission project.
Authority's Engineer issued Completion Certificate for ₹1,323.52 Cr EPC Delhi-Saharanpur Highway project (Ch. 14.750 to 31.600) declaring it operational w.e.f. 12 September 2024.
Received provisional completion certificate for ₹684.00 Cr Jalbehra Shahbad Greenfield Highway HAM project effective August 27, 2026.

Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited signed a Transmission Service Agreement with CTUIL for an Inter-State Transmission System evacuating power from Lakadia Phase-II (7.5 GW), Khambhaliya Phase-II (5.5 GW) and Jamnagar Phase-

timeline.summary: Ceigall India incorporated Ceigall Ambala Chandigarh Zirakpur Limited as a step-down SPV for its NHAI highway project.
Ceigall India emerged as H1 bidder for a ₹0.14 Cr de-silting contract from the Water Resources Department Punjab.
Ceigall India JV (74% share) won a ₹918.04 Cr LOA from Jaipur Metro Rail Corporation for 10.8 km elevated viaduct and 10 stations over 34 months.
Ceigall India received an LOA for a ₹0.14 Cr de-silting contract from the Water Resources Department, Punjab.

Ceigall India received the Authority's Engineer completion certificate dated 5 May 2026 for 35.15 km of its ₹881 Cr Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway EPC package, completed 26 February 2026 except the de-linking part.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,386.51 Cr (+37.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹126.61 Cr (+70.9% YoY).
On 7 May 2026, Ceigall India reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,386.50 Cr (+37.1% YoY) and PAT of ₹129.00 Cr (+78.3% YoY), backed by an order book of ₹18,554.30 Cr.
Ceigall India filed the ICRA Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 confirming deployment of IPO proceeds in line with objects.
Megha Kainth (ICSI F7639) shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 results via ceigall.com on May 7, 2026.
Ceigall India reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,386 Cr (+37.1% YoY) with an order book of ₹18,554 Cr.
Ceigall India received an email on May 12, 2026, for setting up a 100 MW Standalone Battery Energy Storage System in Punjab with a project cost of ₹250 Cr.
On 13 May 2026, Ceigall India was selected by PSPCL for a 50 MW standalone BESS in Punjab at a project cost of about ₹125 Cr, with 18 months of execution and a 12-year BESPA at ₹2.99/kWh.
Ceigall India announced that its Southern Ayodhya Bypass project achieved 35% physical progress 92 days ahead of schedule.
Ceigall India executed an SPA to sell step-down unit Ceigall Malout Abohar Sadhuwali Highways to Neo Infra Income Opportunity Fund for ₹177 Cr.
Ceigall India executed a Share Purchase Agreement to divest CMASH to Neo Infra Income Opportunity Fund for ~₹177 Cr.
Ceigall India reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹888.8 Cr and PAT of ₹51.3 Cr.
Ceigall India Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings call on August 10, 2026, reporting 15.7% YoY revenue growth to ₹970 Cr and an order book of ₹18,568 Cr.
Delhi PWD cancelled the ₹330.84 Cr road strengthening tender where Ceigall India had been L1 bidder.
Ceigall India JV received 4 LOAs from MoRTH totaling ₹2,149.62 Cr (Ceigall share 74%) for EPC packages on NH-913 in Arunachal Pradesh.
Ceigall India-Sushee Infra Mining JV received four LOAs from MoRTH worth ₹2,149.62 Cr for NH-913 EPC projects in Arunachal Pradesh on August 17, 2026.
Ceigall India-Rajinder Infrastructure JV (70:30) received a ₹274.08 Cr LOA from MoRTH for NH-913 EPC package in Arunachal Pradesh.
Approved ₹29.44 Cr equity infusion and security creation for rupee term loans in Ceigall Indore Ujjain Greenfield Highway SPV.
Ceigall India released a press statement highlighting five LOAs totaling ₹2,423.70 Cr on NH-913 Arunachal Pradesh won over two days.
Received a ₹225 Cr LOA from HPSIDC for Phase-I development of Bulk Drug Park at Una, Himachal Pradesh (18-month execution).
Received LOA from MoRTH for ₹704.70 Cr EPC highway project on NH-913 in Arunachal Pradesh via 74% JV.
Ceigall India emerged as L1 bidder for RECPDCL interstate transmission system with annual transmission charges of ₹608.67 Cr for 35 years.
Wholly owned subsidiary Ceigall Green Energy MH2 commissioned first 5 MW of 147 MW solar project under MSKVY 2.0 ahead of schedule.
Received LoI from RECPDCL for ₹5,300 Cr Gujarat transmission project with ₹608.67 Cr annual transmission charges for 35 years.
Received LoI from RECPDCL for ₹5,300 Cr (incl. GST) transmission project in Gujarat with ₹608.67 Cr annual charges for 35 years.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹969.64 Cr (+15.7% YoY), net profit ₹63.75 Cr (+24.2% YoY).
Emerged as H1 bidder for a ₹214.52 Cr (excl. taxes) 5-year stone block mining lease in Nawada from Government of Bihar.
Board approved SPA to acquire 100% of JKJTL from RECPDCL for ₹5 Lakh and subscribing 49% in proposed JV HC Concessions.
Ceigall India's subsidiary commissioned another 5 MW solar plant in Maharashtra, reaching 10 MW of its 147 MW MSKVY 2.0 project.
2026-09-25: Management Committee approved ₹61.93 Cr equity infusion into Ceigall Sahebganj Bettiah Highway Limited for Bihar highway project
2026-09-30: Received LOI from Government of Bihar for ₹214.52 Cr stone mining project
Acquired 100% equity in transmission SPV Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited from RECPDCL for ₹18.40 Cr.
Ceigall India received completion certificate dated 12 October 2026 for ₹1,324 Cr Delhi-Saharanpur Highway EPC package.
Ceigall India received a provisional completion certificate for the ₹684 Cr Haryana HAM highway project.

On 19 October 2026, wholly owned subsidiary Jam Khambhaliya Jamnagar Power Transmission Limited signed a Transmission Service Agreement with CTUIL for an Inter-State Transmission System evacuating power from Lakadia, Khambhaliya and Jamnagar.
2026-10-21: Ceigall India announced financial close for the ₹2,160.00 Cr Sahebganj Bettiah Highway project.
